title: Explicit Meaning — Skill Check
description: Identify information the passage states directly.
subject: rla
author: Chee Skool
reviewNotes: Unseen independent check; no hints, retries, or guided scaffolding.

questions.prompt: Which employees may check out a cordless drill without advance approval?

options.text: Any employee scheduled for maintenance work
options.whyWrong: The passage limits this permission to trained employees.

options.text: Employees who completed tool-safety training
Only supervisors
options.whyWrong: Supervisors approve specialized tools, not every cordless drill.

options.text: Employees who submit an overnight note
options.whyWrong: The overnight note concerns keeping a tool overnight, not ordinary checkout.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice matches the passage without adding or changing what the text says.
explanation.quickTip: Use only what the passage actually supports.

questions.prompt: Which tool still requires supervisor approval before checkout?

options.text: Cordless drill
options.whyWrong: A trained employee may check out a cordless drill without advance approval.

options.text: Standard wrench
options.whyWrong: Standard hand tools do not require advance approval for trained employees.

options.text: Thermal camera
Paper sign-out log
options.whyWrong: The paper log is a record, not a tool being checked out.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice matches the passage without adding or changing what the text says.
explanation.quickTip: Use only what the passage actually supports.

questions.prompt: What must an employee do before keeping a tool overnight?

options.text: Enter an overnight note before 3:00 p.m.
Place the tool in the red inspection bin
options.whyWrong: That action is for damaged tools.

options.text: Wait until the digital station fails
options.whyWrong: The paper process is only for outages.

options.text: Ask the coordinator to transfer the record first
options.whyWrong: Transfer happens after paper entries are used during an outage.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice matches the passage without adding or changing what the text says.
explanation.quickTip: Use only what the passage actually supports.

questions.prompt: A damaged cable locator is returned near the end of a shift. What does the procedure explicitly require?

options.text: Return it to its normal shelf and email the supervisor
options.whyWrong: Damaged tools are not returned to the normal shelf.

options.text: Keep it overnight until a supervisor can inspect it
options.whyWrong: The passage gives a specific damage procedure instead.

options.text: Record it only in the paper log
options.whyWrong: The paper log is for digital outages, not damage.

options.text: Put it in the red inspection bin and complete a damage report

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice matches the passage without adding or changing what the text says.
explanation.quickTip: Use only what the passage actually supports.

questions.prompt: When should staff use the paper sign-out log?

options.text: Whenever a specialized tool is checked out
options.whyWrong: Specialized tools require approval, but the digital station is still the normal record.

options.text: Only when the digital station is unavailable
Whenever a tool will stay out overnight
options.whyWrong: Overnight use requires a note, not automatically a paper log.

options.text: During the first six weeks of the new procedure
options.whyWrong: The six weeks are the review period, not a paper-log period.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice matches the passage without adding or changing what the text says.
explanation.quickTip: Use only what the passage actually supports.

questions.prompt: Which statement is explicitly stated about the six-week review?

options.text: It will decide whether all supervisor approvals can end
options.whyWrong: The passage does not say approvals will be removed.

options.text: It will measure employee satisfaction with the tool room
It will check whether missing-tool reports decreased
It will replace the digital system with the paper log if one tool is lost

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice matches the passage without adding or changing what the text says.
explanation.quickTip: Use only what the passage actually supports.
